name: caddy
description: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
one_liner: A web server that automatically gets and renews the padlock/HTTPS certificate for any website it runs, so you never have to manually deal with SSL certificates again.
buyer: A small hosting provider or agency running many client websites who wants to stop paying for or manually renewing SSL certificates.
business_use_cases: A boutique web hosting provider runs it as the front door for dozens of client sites, eliminating manual certificate renewal work.
An internal IT team uses it to give every internal tool and service automatic HTTPS without a dedicated security engineer.
A dev agency deploys it as a reverse proxy in front of client apps to standardize TLS across all their deployments.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed hosting/ops for small businesses built on top of it, selling the simplicity of zero-maintenance HTTPS as a feature.
Sell infrastructure setup and migration consulting for companies moving off nginx/Apache to simplify their TLS operations.

steal_this: This is mature infrastructure software, not a weekend product opportunity; the honest move is using it as a free building block inside a hosting or agency offering, not building a new business around it directly.
